subject: Airtight Health — Private deployment architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@airtighthealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: infra@airtighthealth.com
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Private deploy architecture review for Airtight — VPC / air-gapped items

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to get into a technical deep-dive to align on the private deployment pattern (VPC-hosted controllers, on-prem worker pools, and an air-gapped option). High-level asks from our infra/security teams:

- Network boundary diagram and expected egress points
- KMS/HSM integration options and key custody model
- Audit log forwarding and retention guarantees
- Certificate / CA requirements for air-gapped installs
- Pre-flight checklist for on-prem install (hardware/OS packages)

Can we schedule a 75-minute session next week to walk the architecture and call out any non-starters? Our prefered windows (UK timezone) are:
- Tue 18 May, 14:00–16:00 BST
- Wed 19 May, 09:00–11:00 BST

I've attached a short SOW excerpt that lists our compliance constraints. If you can share a one-page pre-read and who from Redwood should join (network/security/ops), we can ensure the right people are there.

Thanks,
— Sara Lim
Senior Infra Engineer
Airtight Health

Attachments: Airtight-SOW-summary.pdf
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@airtighthealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy architecture review for Airtight — VPC / air-gapped items

Hi Sara — great to see this moving forward.

Thanks for the SOW excerpt. We can absolutely run a 75-minute deep-dive; internal recommendation is to set aside 90 minutes to allow for Q&A and follow-ups. Proposed slots (converted to BST):
- Tue 18 May, 14:00–15:30 BST (we'd split: 30m architecture walkthrough, 45m Q&A + action mapping)
- Wed 19 May, 09:00–10:30 BST

Suggested Redwood attendees:
- Ben Carter (Sales lead) — coordination + deployment runbook
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineering) — network & install patterns
- Kimberly Park (Security & Compliance) — audit/KMS conversation
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — rollout cadence and support model

Pre-read: I'll share a short checklist and a link to our private deploy playbook. Can you confirm whether the air-gapped environment will permit bringing a USB-preloaded installation bundle (we know some customers cannot accept that), and whether you have an on-prem technical contact for hardware details?

I'll hold the Tue 18 May slot tentatively and will send an invite once you confirm.

On calendar/coordination: we prefer to use a calendar invite with a short Drive pre-read and a separate non-networked runbook share if needed for air-gapped customers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@airtighthealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy architecture review for Airtight — VPC / air-gapped items

Adding a few technical notes so we can be efficient in the meeting:

Agenda (proposed, 75–90m):
1) Introductions & scope (5–10m)
2) Target topology walkthrough (VPC controller, worker pools, on-prem agent) & network flows (20m)
3) Air-gapped install flows and constraints (20m)
4) KMS/HSM options & key rotation policy (10m)
5) Audit logs, metrics, and evidence collection (10m)
6) Open Q&A & next steps (15m)

Preflight asks from our side (please share before the call):
- List of on-prem systems to be integrated (NATs, proxies, SIEMs)
- Any IP allowlists or strict egress policies
- Whether you require an on-site engineer for install day

Kimberly, can you confirm the SOC evidence we'd need to surface during the call? If Airtight has specific retention SLAs we should know that ahead of time.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@airtighthealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: infra@airtighthealth.com
Date: 2027-05-14T18:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy architecture review for Airtight — VPC / air-gapped items

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. I'm actually in a clinic all day Tuesday and Weds morning is tight for our lead. Apologies for the timezone juggling. Could we move to either:

- Thu 20 May, 10:00–11:30 BST OR
- Fri 21 May, 14:00–15:30 BST

On the preflight items: we can share a list of connected systems and whether they'll accept outbound TLS to your ingest endpoints. Regarding the air-gapped install: we cannot accept USB media for code or images; it will need to be provisioned via a controlled jump-host that we manage. We'll bring our on-prem lead (Tomás Rivera) once the time is confirmed.

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a sanitized install runbook that we can review offline (no network access)? That would help our security review.

Thanks,
Sara

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@airtighthealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy architecture review for Airtight — VPC / air-gapped items

Sara — thanks for the context and the constraints (very helpful). Thu 20 May, 10:00–11:30 BST works for our team; I'll send a calendar invite (attached) with a link to the pre-read and the sanitized install runbook PDF.

What I'll attach/share before the meeting:
- Redwood private-deploy checklist (sanitized) — redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf
- Architecture pre-read (drive link) — covers VPC controller, on-prem connector, and air-gap patterns
- Proposed agenda & roles (we'll list owner for each action)

Action items for Airtight before the call:
1) Share list of on-prem systems and whether outbound TLS to our collectors is allowed.
2) Confirm Tomás Rivera as technical on-prem lead and his timezone.
3) Any strict retention window for logs that we must match.

Kimberly will lead the evidence conversation during the session (audit logs, KMS options). Karthik will walk the topology and install flows. Marissa will note rollout support and SLA questions.

I'll send the invite and the pre-read shortly. Appreciate the flexibility — speak Thu 20 May.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ben-calendar-invite.ics; redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf
